data.one_liner: A Flutter slider and range slider with gradient tracks and customizable image thumbs.
data.what_it_does: Provides Slider and RangeSlider widgets that support gradient active/inactive tracks, image‑based thumbs, buffer tracks, and extensive styling options. It wraps a regular Slider/RangeSlider, merging its settings with the inherited SliderTheme.
use_when: You need a gradient‑styled slider or range slider
You want to show a download/playback buffer on a slider
You require custom thumb images instead of the default material thumb
avoid_when: A plain, unstyled slider is sufficient
You need a highly performance‑critical slider with minimal overhead
strengths: Gradient track styling for both active and inactive portions
Custom thumb images via asset or any ImageProvider
Support for secondary (buffer) track and full theming integration
weaknesses: Thumb hiding is only supported for single sliders, not range sliders
Limited to Flutter platforms; no web‑specific optimizations
data.minimal_example:
GradientSlider(
  thumbAsset: 'assets/vert_thumb.png',
  thumbHeight: 30,
  thumbWidth: 30,
  trackBorder: 1,
  activeTrackGradient: const LinearGradient(colors: [Colors.pink, Colors.blue]),
  slider: Slider(value: 0.5, onChanged: (v) {}),
);
